description: List products in the store, with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, search, field selection, and expansion. Swell backend REST API: GET /products.

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand, e.g. "variants,categories".

limit.description: Max records to return (1–1000, Swell default 15).

search.description: Free-text search across the model's searchable fields.

sort.description: Sort expression, e.g. "date_created desc" or "name asc".

where.description: MongoDB-style filter as a JSON object string, e.g. {"active":true,"price":{"$gte":10}}.

name: swell_list_products
title: List products
